content: वेदिका .²1 A sacrificial altar or ground; इति प्रिये वादिनि वेदिकोदरी <ls>Rām. Ch. 2. 57</ls>. .²2 A raised seat; an elevated spot of ground (usually for sacred purposes); सप्तपर्णवेदिका <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; सदेवदारुद्रुमवेदिकायाम् <ls>Ku. 3. 44</ls>. .²3 A seat in general. .²4 An altar, a heap, mound; मन्दाकिनीसैकतवेदिकाभिः <ls>Ku. 1. 29</ls> ‘by making altars or heaps of sand <ab>&c.</ab>’. .²5 A quadrangular open shed in the middle of a court-yard; a pavilion, balcony; तप्तकाञ्चनवेदिकम् (जग्राह); <ls>Rām. 7. 15. 37</ls>; सुरवेश्मवेदिका <ls>Ki. 7. 12</ls>. .²6 An arbour, a bower.
